description: Land Acquisition - Minneriya, Hingurakgoda D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that a specific parcel of land (0.0736 Hectare in Minneriya village) is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The entire content focuses on land and property-related matters, specifically the acquisition process, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification. While a minister's name and title are present, the core subject is land acquisition, not a government personnel or structural change.
